name: io.github.MikeyPetrillo/agent402
title: Agent402.Tools: payments and trust for AI agents
description: Payment and trust layer for agentic commerce (Agentic Finance): pay and verify over x402 and MPP

tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: Keyword search over the Agent402 catalog of 500+ tools (615 loaded by this connector). Returns { results, workflows }; run one with catalog.call. 186 pure-CPU tools run free here (proof-of-work). The others are paid per call, payable here in the call over x402 or MPP (the payment rides in _meta), or through npx agent402-mcp with a wallet.

query.description: What you need, e.g. "search the web for x402", "answer a question with citations", "decode JWT"

tools.name: catalog.find
tools.description: Resolve a task description to the single best-matching Agent402 tool, returned call-ready: slug, price, input schema and a worked example. Use catalog.search to compare several candidates. Returns { task, results } with the top pick first; run it with catalog.call and the slug and params it lists.

task.description: What you want to do, e.g. "search the web for x402 adoption" or "convert miles to km"

tools.name: catalog.call
tools.description: Run an Agent402 tool by slug, with params matching that tool's inputSchema; find slugs with catalog.find or catalog.search. The 186 pure-CPU tools run free here, rate-limited, through proof-of-work. Paid tools are payable here, in the call, over x402 or MPP (the first answer carries the ask). An unknown slug returns an error.

params.description: Tool input, matching the tool's inputSchema

tools.name: payment.info
tools.description: How paying for Agent402 tools works. This connector holds no wallet: 186 pure-CPU tools run free through proof-of-work, and the rest settle in USDC over x402 or MPP (payable here, in the call, over x402 or MPP). Covers wallet setup, per-call and session spend caps, the payment rails, and checking a wallet's balance. Returns { connector, freeTier, pay, spendControls, balanceAndHistory }.

tools.name: pdf.markdown
tools.description: Paid ($0.003/call): Convert a PDF to clean markdown: headings, paragraphs, and bullets reconstructed from the text layer - ready to drop into a model's context. Body: {"url":"https://…/file.pdf"}. Returns { pages, wordCount, markdown }.

tools.name: macro.series
tools.description: Paid ($0.001/call): US economic series by series ID, from the agency that publishes each; accepts the common series IDs: GDP and PCE (GDPC1, PCEPI), jobs and prices (UNRATE, CPIAUCSL), Treasury yields (DGS10, T10YIE), money (M2SL), FX (DEXUSEU), rates (FEDFUNDS). Units and frequencies; other IDs answer 404 listing those served. Sources: U.S. BLS, BEA, U.S.

seriesId.description: series ID, one of: UNRATE, UNRATENSA, U6RATE, CIVPART, EMRATIO, PAYEMS, CES0500000003, JTSJOL, CPIAUCSL, CPIAUCNS, CPILFESL, PPIACO, EFFR, DFF, FEDFUNDS, SOFR, OBFR, GFDEBTN, DGS1MO, DGS3MO, DGS6MO, DGS1, DGS2, DGS3, DGS5, DGS7, DGS10, DGS20, DGS30, T10Y2Y, T10Y3M, M1SL, M2SL, M1NS, M2NS, GDP, GDPC1, UNEMPLOY, CLF16OV, CE16OV, USPRIV, MANEMP, AHETPI, AWHAETP, AWHNONAG, JTSJOR, JTSHIR, JTSQUR, CPIUFDSL, CPIENGSL, CUSR0000SAH1, PPIFIS, PCEPI, PCEPILFE, PCE, PCEC96, PI, DSPI, PSAVERT, DEXUSEU, DEXUSUK, DEXUSAL, DEXJPUS, DEXCHUS, DEXCAUS, DEXMXUS, DEXSZUS, DEXKOUS, DEXINUS, DEXBZUS, DTWEXBGS, DTWEXAFEGS, DTWEXEMEGS, MPRIME, TB3MS, TB6MS, TB1YR, GS1, GS2, GS5, GS10, GS20, GS30, DFII5, DFII7, DFII10, DFII20, DFII30, T5YIE, T10YIE

startDate.description: ISO start date (YYYY-MM-DD), optional; without one a Bureau of Labor Statistics series answers its last 10 years, a daily Treasury or exchange-rate series its last 2 calendar years

units.description: Transformation: lin, chg, ch1, pch, pc1 (YoY %), pca, cca, log

frequency.description: Average to a lower frequency: d, w (weeks ending Friday, also wef), m, q, sa, a (optional)

tools.name: weather.current
tools.description: Paid ($0.002/call): Current weather conditions for any location on Earth: temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind speed/direction/gusts, precipitation, cloud cover, pressure, and human-readable condition. Global coverage by coordinates or place name; no account needed. Cached for up to 5 minutes. ?lat=48.86&lon=2.35 or ?place=Paris. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).

lat.description: Latitude, -90 to 90 (with lon; wins over place)

place.description: A city, town or region name instead of lat/lon, for example "Paris" or "Austin, TX" (not a street address); the answer echoes the place it resolved to

tools.name: browser.render
tools.description: Paid ($0.003/call): Read a page as clean markdown, rendering it in a real headless Chromium browser (JavaScript executed) when the page needs it. Use this for SPAs and JS-heavy sites where plain fetching returns an empty shell; a page whose served HTML already carries its content is read without the browser, faster, and answers rendered: false.

tools.name: audio.transcribe
tools.description: Paid ($0.030/call): Transcribe audio to text with the gpt-transcribe model. Provide a URL to an audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, etc.) and get back the transcript. Add diarize:true for speaker labels, word timestamps and a language confidence score (the scribe-v2 model, same price). No API key needed; pay per call via x402.

url.description: URL of the audio file to transcribe (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, webm)

language.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr') for better accuracy

diarize.description: true: transcribe with the scribe-v2 model and add speaker labels and word timestamps (`words`, `speakers`) and `language_confidence` (0 to 1, the model's confidence in the detected language). Same price and cap. Default false

model.description: Optional: a model to transcribe with in place of gpt-transcribe, one of mistralai/voxtral-mini-transcribe-3-0, mistralai/voxtral-small-transcribe-3-0, microsoft/mai-transcribe-2 (model-backed; same price and cap; not with diarize). The answer names the model that served it.

tools.name: memory.read
tools.description: Paid ($0.001/call): Read from a wallet-scoped namespace. ?key=… returns the stored value; omit key to list keys. The read half of memory-write's exact-key store. For similarity retrieval over remembered text, call the catalog slug memory-recall (on MCP, through catalog.call). Reads your own namespace by default; add ?owner=0x… to read a namespace you've been granted access to.

key.description: Key to read; omit to list all keys

owner.description: Optional 0x namespace to read (requires a grant)

tools.name: memory.write
tools.description: Paid ($0.001/call): Persistent key-value memory for agents, scoped to the paying wallet. Your x402 payment IS your authentication: the wallet that pays owns the namespace. No signup, no API keys. Exact-key storage for structured state. For retrieval by MEANING rather than key, use the catalog slugs memory-remember and memory-recall (on MCP, through catalog.call with that slug).

ttlSeconds.description: Optional: auto-expire the key after N seconds

owner.description: Optional 0x namespace to write into (requires a readwrite grant)

delete.description: Set true to delete the key instead

requestId.description: Optional client id for this write; a retry with the same id returns the first answer

tools.name: decide.plan
tools.description: Paid ($0.010/call): Describe a job and get a call-ready plan: which tools, across this catalog and outside x402 sellers with a recently verified 402, solve it end to end, in what order, with fallbacks and input params that validate against each tool's schema.

task.description: What the agent needs done (max 2000 chars)

constraints.description: maxBudgetUsd, maxLatencyMs, rails [x402|mpp], chains [CAIP-2 or namespace], excludeSellers [host], requireDeterministic

tools.name: decide.execute
tools.description: Paid ($0.001/call): Run a decision's plan (decisionId from POST /api/decide), or a free plan sketch (steps), through Agent402: first-party steps run directly, third-party steps are bought from the seller and resold to you at Agent402's price (paid with a wallet on Base; prepaid credits and cards do not pay this route).

steps.description: Instead of decisionId: the tool slugs of a free plan sketch (from /api/find or /api/route), 2 to 5, in order. Pass params for step 1; a later step takes its one required input from the step before.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Spend ceiling for the run (default: the plan's estimate via Agent402)

params.description: Per-step params overriding the plan's exampleParams, keyed by step number

replan.description: With decisionId: plan the saved task again on current prices and reliability, then run the new plan. Adds the plan price for that decision's depth to the quote; the answer's replanned field lists what changed. Default false.

tools.name: demand.request
tools.description: [free] Report a capability the 500+ tools do not cover, after catalog.search or catalog.find found nothing that fits. Requests are clustered by need, and frequent ones get built. Records demand only: it runs nothing. Same intake as POST https://agent402.tools/api/wish; aggregate demand is public at https://agent402.tools/api/wishes.

need.description: What you needed and could not find, in your own words, e.g. "convert a HEIC image to JPEG" or "look up a UK company by registration number"

context.description: Optional: what you were trying to accomplish, or the input you had - helps disambiguate similar-sounding requests.

tools.name: server.describe
tools.description: [free] Describe this connector: the tools it lists, how to install (Claude Code / Cursor / npm), free vs paid tiers, and discovery URLs.

tools.name: decide.feedback
tools.description: [free] Report whether one step of a decide.plan decision worked (success or failure, optional 1-5 quality and latency). Needs the decisionId and feedbackToken that decide.plan returned; one verdict per step, a later report replaces it. Reports feed tool reliability in future rankings.

toolId.description: Optional: a fallback you used instead of the step's primary tool
